stem.text: A molecule behaves as an electric ‘dipole’ consisting of two equal point charges of opposite sign, separated by a fixed distance. The molecule moves with constant horizontal velocity as it enters a vertical uniform electric field, as shown.

stem.alt: Small circle containing a minus sign above a plus sign, with an arrow pointing right; several vertical arrows pointing down labelled electric field; the label molecule beside the circle.

stem.text: The positive and negative charges of the molecule enter the field at the same time.
What describes the effect of the electric field on the velocity of the molecule?
